College Football - Boston College at SMU

The Boston College Eagles face the No. 21 SMU Mustangs at Gerald J. Ford Stadium in an ACC game. SMU defeated Missouri State, 34-24, behind Kevin Jennings' 464 passing yards. Boston College lost to Virginia Tech, 21-14, in the previous week.
College Football - Wyoming at North Dakota State

The Cowboys (2-2) visit the Bison (4-0) at the Fargodome in a Mountain West test. North Dakota State beat Sacramento State, 31-10, while Wyoming beat Hawaii, 27-10, as Markell Holman ran for 87 yards and two TDs, and Samuel Harris added 94 yards.

College Football - Texas State at San Diego State

The Bobcats (2-2) take on the Aztecs (1-3) in Week 5 as Pac-12 play continues in the NCAA. Texas State beat Incarnate Word, 63-10, behind five first-half touchdowns from Brad Jackson, while San Diego State fell, 41-16, to Toledo.
